scientific_integrity.computational_evidence: Standalone script independently verifies actual hull areas and geometric intersections on finite grids; simulations and finite computations do not prove the continuum theorem.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Four-corner reduction, diagonal-pair identity, circle-overlap integration and onset scaling.
scientific_integrity.scope: Exact uniform-shift hull area law for every radius below one unit, with near-threshold critical exponents.

scientific_limitations: Square lattice and circular Euclidean disk of radius less than one unit.
Zero-area convention includes the empty and lower-dimensional convex hulls.
No assertion for disks of radius at least one unit or other shapes.
Historical priority against inaccessible earlier digitization papers remains provisional.
title: A three-atom area law and two critical exponents for randomly translated lattice-disk hulls
